answer: Make every new identity post a refundable stake locked until five established peers attest its first useful work, so fakes cost real capital. A public ledger tracks each stake like a reef: healthy growth is slow and visible, while a sudden swarm of identical newcomers stands out. Accounts with no history may only observe, not earn or vote, until attested — the oasis of trust is reached by verifiable work, not cloning. A prism check splits each applicant's writing, timing, and stake source into separate signals, so one reused pattern across many accounts flags the whole cluster for quarantine.
